text: Hallelujah!Praise God in his holy sanctuary; [1] [AA]give praise in the mighty dome of heaven.
Give praise for his mighty deeds, [AB]praise him for his great majesty.
Give praise with blasts upon the horn, [AC]praise him with harp and lyre.
Give praise with tambourines and dance,praise him with strings and pipes. [AD]
Give praise with crashing cymbals,praise him with sounding cymbals.
Let everything that has breathgive praise to the Lord! [AE]Hallelujah!
